brief:
A deeply divided Israel heads to the polls in what Al-Monitor described as a pivotal election that will determine Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political fate. The outcome carries significance for the country's direction on security, governance, and Netanyahu's own legal standing amid ongoing challenges to his leadership.

Voters face a choice between Netanyahu's continued rule and an alternative path as the nation navigates internal fractures and external pressures. The election result will shape Israel's approach to major policy questions in the coming years.

title: Israel votes on Netanyahu's political future in pivotal election
